}, render: function (input, metrics) { var W = input.viewport.widthDu; var H = input.viewport.heightDu; var left = Math.min(Math.max(W * 0.12, 50), W * 0.25); var right = Math.min(Math.max(W * 0.05, 20), W * 0.15); var maxAmp = 4.6; var yScale = plotH / (2 * maxAmp); var x1 = left + plotW; var paths = []; var children = []; var counter = 0; function nextId(prefix) { counter += 1; return prefix + '_' + counter; } function addPath(id, commands, fill, sw, dash) { paths.push({id: id, commands: commands}); addPath(nextId(curve.prefix), [['M', prevX, prevY], ['L', nx, ny]], curve.color, curve.sw); prevX = nx; prevY = ny; } } addSegment(left, centerY, x1, centerY, '#26354a', 1.8); addSegment(left, centerY - maxAmp * yScale, left, centerY + maxAmp * yScale, '#26354a', 1.8);
